definitions.explanation: Something that was left behind or forgotten.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I left something on the train.

examples.japanese: {忘|わす}れ{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧か⟦{確認|かくにん}してください→確認：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: Please check that you haven't forgotten anything.

examples.japanese: {忘|わす}れ{物|もの}センター⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせてください→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧。
examples.english: Please contact the lost and found center.

notes:
{忘|わす}れ{物|もの} refers to an item that someone has left behind or forgotten to bring, especially on public transport or at a venue. Japan has a well-organized lost-and-found system, making this a practically useful word.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {忘|わす}れ{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave something behind
- {忘|わす}れ{物|もの}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧: lost and found center
- {忘|わす}れ{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Do you have all your belongings? (common announcement)
- {忘|わす}れ{物|もの}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: reminder to check for forgotten items

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧: something dropped (accidentally)
- ⟦{失|な}くし{物|もの}→失くし物：28874_nakushimono⟧: something lost (whereabouts unknown)

Japan's trains and police stations have dedicated {忘|わす}れ{物|もの} offices. The recovery rate for lost items is remarkably high.
